title: Pumpkin Stir Fry
description: A delicious and healthy stir fry made with pumpkin, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Heat the nutty oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pumpkin and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the stir-fry spice mix and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the cozy soy sauce and silky honey, and stir-fry for a final 2 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
